name: Ghost Stampede OLD
description: Four massive skulls of aurochs, enormous wild cattle, rise into the air, each trailing its ghostly body behind it.
disable: DC 36 Nature (master) to calm one of the four aurochs or DC 40 Religion (trained) to exorcise them
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area or after all four aurochs skulls are destroyed. After 1 hour, if at least one aurochs skull remains, the haunt reactivates.
routine: (4 actions) For each aurochs skull disabled or destroyed, the haunt has 1 fewer action. On each action, a different aurochs moves up to 60 feet and attempts a horn Strike against a different living creature. A creature critically hit by a horn Strike also takes 2d6 Bleed Damage and is knocked Prone.

generalAbilities.name: Defend Territory
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of an aurochs skull

Effect The skulls rise into the air, form ghostly bodies, and bellow in rage. Each creature within 60 feet of an aurochs skull must attempt a DC 36 Will Saving Throw saving throw. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature takes (1d12+6) Mental Damage damage and is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature takes (2d12+12) Mental Damage damage and is Frightened 4.
